review_description: Polite, tidy and punctual installation removing all of the existing system.Installed all the elements I wanted.Excellent customer service and a good review by the electrical inspector.

The initial process was quick, received a visit from a salesperson.  Waiting for the system was an ongoing delay.  Was meant to be installed in December 2019.  Was finally installed February 2020. Dont try calling their office number - no-one ever answers the call - it is diverted to an answering machine and no-one bother to get back to you.Their office shows as being in hindmarsh, but the phone number is a Sydney number. I contacted them numerous times (via a mobile number that I had kept) to complete installing a piece of equipment in the meter box. This took approx 4 calls before they came back out and completed the install. I tried to call another 10 times and believe me I have kept the records for someone to come out and make sure the system was working as it should, since our power bill was still in the $800 area. The installer said he was close by - 30 mins was completing a job and would come after. Received a call from him later to say he had been held up on the job and would speak with his higher ups as to when he could come back to check. I also need help understanding the APP, bloody useless, no help - no-one has come back as PROMISED.  Don't waste your money.  I made the mistake of paying for the whole system before it was completely finished to my satisfaction.
Installation took 3-4 weeks. Person promised to Install witin a week But finished around four weeks. Thanks
Friendly and very informative, maintained contact throughout the process, grid connection has now been applied for today also by them.  18kW system installed.
